name: Collapsing Ceiling
disable: DC 21 Crafting check (trained) to support the damaged area against a collapse

items.name: Falling Rocks
items.text:
Trigger A creature enters a square where the ceiling's structure is weakened

---
Effect Rocks fall in the square, dealing 4d8+10 bludgeoning damage (DC 25 basic Reflex save save) to anyone in that square. The square also turns into greater difficult terrain.

text: A 5-foot-square section in the ceiling is in danger of collapsing. A character can use a Crafting check instead of a Perception check to detect the hazard.
